name: Crayon lithograph
summary: The artist draws with greasy crayon directly on a grained limestone, and the grain catches the crayon as speckled black. The print keeps the drawing's pressure, from pale grain to dense black, with no engraved line.

philosophy.core_thesis: A greasy crayon on a grained stone keeps the pressure of the hand, so that a drawing prints as drawn, with no engraver between.
design_principles: Draw in black crayon on a grained stone; press harder for a darker tone.
Let the grain of the stone speckle the pale tones, at about 80 grains an inch.
Scrape or scratch the whites out of the black with a needle or a blade.
Add the caption in lithographic script under the picture, in the same ink.
Print in one black ink on thin paper, so that a paper can run in thousands.
Keep the edges soft and smudged; do not trace a hard contour.
anti_patterns: Halftone dots or a photographic tone
A digital line of even width

process.image_making: Greasy crayon drawn on stone; gum-etched; inked with roller; scratched whites
process.edition: Hundreds to thousands; newspaper editions in the thousands

inks.strategy: One black greasy ink that the stone takes where the crayon was drawn.

screening.rule: Make the tone with the crayon grain that the stone gives, about 80 grains an inch; press harder to close the grain to black.

registration.rule: One stone prints the whole image in one pass, so no register is needed.

substrate.stock: Thin wove newsprint or chine-collé paper, ivory.
substrate.finish: Smooth and thin, with a soft tooth that takes the grain.

surface.impression: None; the print lies flat on the sheet, with no plate mark.
surface.sheen: Matt black, with a slight grease sheen in the darks.
surface.texture: A fine speckle in the grey tones, and smooth black where the crayon was dense.

positive: caricature of judges, lawyers and politicians

evidence.title: The Doctor, published in Le Charivari
The Trains of Pleasure, Le Charivari

emotion.target_response: Quick, sharp wit: the viewer reads a satirical drawing that was made the same week.

use_cases: political posters with a drawn look
avoid_when: The image needs an exact line.
The design needs colour from several plates.

modifiers.how: Draw a stone for each colour and print them in order, from light to dark.
Replace the crayon with an engraved line of even width and add plate marks.
